description: Returns the ground-truth schema of your Firestore collections by sampling real documents. For each collection you get field names, observed types, and presence rates. Use this BEFORE writing any database code to avoid hallucinating field names. Stable fields (≥80% presence, single type) are safe to use. Fields marked with a note need attention (drift, sparse, or optional).

collection.description: Name of a single collection to inspect. Omit to get the schema of ALL collections.

format.description: Output format. Use "md" to write Obsidian-compatible Markdown files to disk.

keyPath.description: Absolute or relative path to the Firebase service account JSON file.

outPath.description: Path to write Markdown output. For a single collection: full file path (e.g. "./docs/schema/users.md"). For all collections: directory path (e.g. "./.lintbase/schema").

sampleSize.description: Max documents to sample per collection (default: 50).

name: lintbase_get_schema
title: LintBase Get Schema
